title: Comment on ""Proximity effect in ultrafin Pb/Ag multilayers within the Cooper limit"
abstract: I present here critical comment to the recent e-print "Proximity effect in ultrafin Pb/Ag multilayers within the Cooper limit" by by O.Bourgeois, A.Frydman and R.C.Dynes, demonstrating that the interpretaion of the data presented in cond-mat/0302251 does not seem to be reliable, and, simulteneously, large amount of previous work was ignored.
